description: This file defines the React-based UI components and logic for managing and displaying snapshots within a trace viewer tool. It includes components for snapshot tabs, view rendering in iframes, snapshot collection, external resource integrations, and interaction handling such as inspection mode. It also contains helper functions for snapshot URL generation and info fetching.

methods.name: collectSnapshots
methods.description: Gathers action snapshots (before, after, input) related to a given trace action, possibly traversing previous or next actions for missing snapshots.

methods.name: extendSnapshot
methods.description: Generates URLs for snapshot images and info pages based on trace ID, snapshot data, and user preferences.

methods.name: fetchSnapshotInfo
methods.description: Fetches and returns details about a snapshot URL, including viewport size and timestamp.
